k: Billy's old friend, now a drug dealer
st: In season 1, Duane asks Billy to help take back a car stereo they installed; Billy says no, but Duane later sees Connors shoot him.
In season 1, now a dealer shielded by Connors, Duane takes Tyrone on, until Connors sets him up to be shot by O'Reilly.
In season 2, a living Duane turns up at the Johnsons' party in one of the dream lives Andre traps Tandy in.

files.notes: Only 'Duane' is said in the transcripts (marvels-cloak-and-dagger-2018 s01e01, s01e03, s01e05, s01e06, s02e06); 'Porter' is never said, so n is Duane. His drug business is never given a name on screen, so tm is Independent. Filed as A (Billy's friend, victim of Connors) though he deals drugs with Connors; he never acts against the heroes. Wiki page file was empty; facts from Wikipedia season 1 and 2 summaries and transcripts. Step 3 is an illusion version (B Sides).

st: In season 1, Greg, Melissa's lawyer boyfriend, presses her Roxxon case and turns O'Reilly away for lack of a warrant.
In season 1, a married man, he shares his Roxxon research with Tandy and is assassinated soon after.

files.notes: Only 'Greg' is said (s01e02 'This is Greg, my boyfriend'; s01e03 'GREG: Warrant'); 'Pressfield' is never said, so n is Greg. His law firm is never named, so tm is Independent. Killing per Wikipedia (Call/Response); s01e08 Tandy tells Scarborough he had Greg killed.

st: In season 1, Ivan Hess lies catatonic, reliving the rig explosion, until Tandy and Tyrone help him reach the core and wake.
In season 1, back with his daughter Mina, Ivan tells Tandy that Nathan hid evidence about the rig in a safe deposit box.

files.notes: Named on screen in s01e06 ('I thought Ivan may know', 'Hi, Mr. Hess') and s01e07 ('You're Ivan Hess'). Group Roxxon (Roxxon Gulf, worked the rig with Nathan). He names the Terrors in s01e07; he is not on screen in the last episode of season 1 or in season 2 (the Dr. Hess of s02e06 is Mina).

st: In season 1, Fuchs, a beat cop, talks over Connors's record with O'Reilly, becomes her boyfriend and vows to help take Connors down.
In season 1, O'Reilly finds Fuchs dead in his fridge, and the police blame Tyrone for his murder.
In season 2, Connors confesses to beating Fuchs to death, and spirits take his face to guide Tandy and taunt O'Reilly.

files.notes: Only 'Fuchs' / 'Officer Fuchs' is said; 'Kenneth' never appears in any transcript, so n is Fuchs. Season 2 appearances are the spirit (Papa Legba per credits, never named so on screen) and a shadow soldier wearing his face (s02e03, s02e08, s02e10); Connors' confession about the railing is s02e05.

add.k: A woman in Lia's support group
st: In season 2, Mikayla joins Lia's support group with bruises from her boyfriend Jeremy, then is found overdosed after Tandy berates her.
In season 2, she is drawn into Andre's trance club with Melissa and others, until Tandy and Tyrone defeat him and free everyone.

files.notes: Only 'Mikayla' is said; 'Bell' never said, so n is Mikayla. Group follows the app's existing 'Lia's support group' (she attends Lia's meetings, s02e01 and s02e02). Her B Sides appearance (s02e06) is an illusion version and is not given a step.

st: In season 1, Nathan Bowen drives Tandy home as the Roxxon rig explodes, and he drowns when their car crashes into the sea.
In season 1, Roxxon blames him for the blast; Tandy hears him in Ivan's memories and learns he was abusive to Melissa.
In season 2, Tandy relives his abuse, sees a life where he lived, then defeats a vision of him in Andre's realm.

files.notes: Name said in s01e01 ('Nathan Bowen's office, please', answers the phone 'Nathan Bowen'). Roxxon Research and Development. All later appearances are visions, memories and illusions.

st: In season 1, Rick, a rich partygoer Tandy robbed, corners and attacks her until she stabs him with a dagger of light.
In season 1, from his hospital bed, Rick Cotton lies to O'Reilly about the attack, and the case is closed.

files.notes: 'Rick' said in s01e01 (his friend calls 'Rick'); 'Mr. Cotton' said by O'Reilly in s01e03, hence the staged name. No group named, so Independent. Never charged on screen.

add.k: Big Chief of the Wild Red Hawks
st: In season 1, Big Chief Roland Duplantier welcomes back his old Spy Boy, Otis, and shows Tyrone the Red Hawks' suits.
In season 1, he visits the Johnsons on the anniversary of Billy's death and stalls the police so Tyrone can slip away.

files.notes: He introduces himself in s01e04: 'I'm Big Chief Roland Duplantier of the Wild Red Hawks of the 9th Ward.' Also on screen in s01e08 (party at the Johnsons') and s01e10 (faces the police at the door).

st: In season 1, Billy tries to send Tyrone home before taking back a car stereo, then is shot by Connors and falls into the water.
In season 1, Billy lives on in Tyrone's visions and a recording, and Tyrone poses as his ghost to win a confession from Connors.
In season 2, a living Billy appears in the dream lives Andre traps Tandy in, and Connors tells Adina where his body lies.

files.notes: 'Billy' said throughout from s01e01; full name 'Billy Johnson' first said in s01e08 ('My name is Billy Johnson', O'Reilly's arrest of Connors), hence staged. Billy's unfinished suit is kept with the Red Hawks (s01e04), but he is never said to be a member, so tm is Independent.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Duane and Billy grow up as friends and install car stereos together. The night Billy goes to take one back, Duane sees Connors shoot him. In a dream life Andre builds for Tandy, both are alive at the Johnsons' party.
stages.whoB: His friend who saw him shot

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Tyrone, Billy's little brother, finds Duane running a business and asks him for work to get at Connors. After Tyrone steals and returns a bag of drugs, Duane takes him on, and Tyrone later sees him killed.
stages.whoA: Billy's brother, who works for him

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Duane deals drugs under Connors's protection, though he knows Connors shot Billy. When Duane pushes back and a bag goes missing, Connors sets him up to be shot by O'Reilly.
stages.whoA: The corrupt cop who protects him
stages.whoB: The dealer he protects, then sets up

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Greg is Melissa's lawyer boyfriend and works her case against Roxxon over Nathan. Tandy warns her he is married, and Melissa breaks up with him before he is killed.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Tandy mocks Greg as another married man after her mother. She comes to see he cares for Melissa and asks to help his Roxxon research, then takes his files after he is killed.
stages.whoA: His girlfriend's daughter, who helps him

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Mina works at Roxxon to carry on her father Ivan's work while he lies catatonic. Tandy and Tyrone reach him by reminding him of Mina, and father and daughter are reunited.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Tandy enters Ivan's mind and finds him reliving the rig explosion, and she helps him reach the core. Awake, he tells her Nathan hid evidence in a safe deposit box.
stages.whoA: Nathan's daughter, who frees his mind
stages.whoB: The scientist whose mind she frees

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Tyrone helps Tandy enter Ivan's mind. Inside the looping rig explosion, he convinces Tandy the voice on the phone is not really her father and helps Ivan reach the core.
stages.whoA: The young man who helps free him

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Ivan and Nathan work the Roxxon rig together, and Nathan calls him just before the explosion. Tandy hears Nathan's voice again inside Ivan's memory of that night.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Fuchs talks over Connors's record with O'Reilly at the precinct, and they start dating over pancakes. She finds him murdered, and later spirits wear his face to taunt her.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Fuchs defends Connors's record at first, then joins O'Reilly's plan to take him down. Connors beats Fuchs to death and frames Tyrone, then later confesses to clear Tyrone.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Tandy meets Mikayla at Lia's support group and loses her temper when Mikayla defends her abusive boyfriend. Feeling guilty, Tandy searches for her and later tries to pull her out of Andre's trance.
stages.whoA: The girl who tries to help her
stages.whoB: A woman from her support group

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Mikayla turns to Lia's support group to get away from her abusive boyfriend. Lia secretly works in Andre's trafficking ring, which preys on women just like her.
stages.whoA: The group leader who preys on her

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Andre draws Mikayla, Melissa and many others into his trance club. Tandy and Tyrone defeat him and set them free.
stages.whoA: The man who traps her in a trance
stages.whoB: One of the people he entrances

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Tyrone finds a drugged Mikayla in a private ambulance and tries to get her out, but the men inside open fire. Later he and Tandy free her and the others from Andre's club.
stages.whoA: The young man who tries to rescue her
stages.whoB: A drugged woman he tries to rescue

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Nathan picks Tandy up from ballet the night the rig explodes and drowns in the crash. She tracks down his evidence against Roxxon, learns he abused her mother, and finally faces a vision of him.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Nathan is Melissa's husband until he dies in the rig explosion. Tandy sees in Melissa's memories that he was abusive toward her, and Tandy relives those memories again later.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Tandy robs Rick, and at a party he corners and attacks her. She stabs him with her first dagger of light and flees.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: O'Reilly questions Rick in the hospital, and he says he saw nothing. Spotting his scratches and unbuckled pants, she works out he was the attacker.
stages.whoA: The detective who sees through him

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Big Chief Roland welcomes Otis back to the Wild Red Hawks as his old Spy Boy. The Red Hawks gather at Otis's home on the anniversary of Billy's death, and Roland stands by the family when the police come.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Roland meets Tyrone when Otis brings him to the Red Hawks, where Tyrone takes on Billy's unfinished suit. When the police come for Tyrone, Roland stalls them at the door.
stages.whoB: The Big Chief who shields him

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Billy is Tyrone's big brother, killed by Connors in front of him. Tyrone finishes Billy's suit and poses as his ghost to get Connors to confess.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Adina is Billy's mother and still grieves his death. Years later she holds Connors captive and makes him tell her where Billy's body lies.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Otis is Billy's father. He takes Tyrone to the Red Hawks, where Billy's unfinished suit waits, and hosts them on the anniversary of Billy's death.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Connors shoots Billy and hides his body. Tyrone haunts him as Billy's ghost until he confesses, and later he tells Adina where the body is.
